name: Bugbear Ambusher
notes: Surprise Attack +2d6 on first hit when target hasn't acted. Brute: deals 2d8 (not 1d8) on all hits. Long-Limbed: 10ft melee reach. Grapple-and-pull: drags defenders off walls. Appears mid-combat from east drainage ditch.
gm_notes: Bugbears are the ambush moment. Don't reveal them until round 3-4 when the party thinks they have the attack contained. They emerge from the east drainage ditch (which wasn't covered because all eyes were west). Their goal: pull 1-2 defenders off the wall. The Surprise Attack + Brute on round 1 = 21 average damage, which downs most L4 characters. Let that land, then show they want to grapple not kill. Creates tactical crisis: melee goes to save the fallen, ranged has to cover both positions.
